petkit_visit_tracker.description: Keeps the time of the last two visits and flags three visits within an hour.

conditions.value_template: {{ trigger.from_state is not none and trigger.from_state.state | is_number and trigger.to_state.state | is_number and trigger.to_state.state | float > trigger.from_state.state | float }}

if.value_template: {% set p = state_attr('input_datetime.cat_previous_toilet_visit','timestamp') | float(0) %}{{ p > 0 and now().timestamp() - p < 3600 }}

petkit_frequent_visits_alert.description: Three visits within an hour can be an early sign of a urinary problem. At most one alert every 3 hours.

data.title: 🐱 Frequent toilet visits
data.message: Your cat has used the toilet 3 times within an hour ({{ states('sensor.guest_bathroom_petkit_t4_visits_today') | int(0) }} today). Watch for straining, crying or very small clumps. If she strains with little or no urine, call the vet.

petkit_no_visit_alert.alias: Cat care: no toilet visit for 14 hours
petkit_no_visit_alert.description: Alerts once when the cat has not used the toilet for 14 hours.

triggers.value_template: {% set l = state_attr('input_datetime.cat_last_toilet_visit','timestamp') | float(0) %}{{ l > 0 and now().timestamp() - l > 14*3600 }}

data.title: 🐱 No toilet visit for 14 hours
data.message: Last visit: {{ as_datetime(state_attr('input_datetime.cat_last_toilet_visit','timestamp') | float(0)) | as_local | as_timestamp | timestamp_custom('%a %H:%M') }}. Check she is OK and has not gone somewhere else; not urinating for 24 hours is an emergency.

petkit_weight_trend_alert.description: Daily at 20:00: compares the last 24 hours' average body mass with the 14-day average.

conditions.value_template: {% set a = states('sensor.guest_bathroom_petkit_t4_cat_body_mass_24_hour_average') | float(0) %}{% set b = states('sensor.guest_bathroom_petkit_t4_cat_body_mass_14_day_average') | float(0) %}{{ a > 1 and b > 1 and (a - b) | abs / b > 0.05 }}

data.title: 🐱 Weight change
data.message: {% set a = states('sensor.guest_bathroom_petkit_t4_cat_body_mass_24_hour_average') | float %}{% set b = states('sensor.guest_bathroom_petkit_t4_cat_body_mass_14_day_average') | float %}Average body mass today {{ a | round(2) }} kg vs {{ b | round(2) }} kg over 14 days ({{ '%+.0f' | format((a - b) / b * 100) }} %). A change over 5 % in days is worth mentioning to your vet.

data.title: 🐱 Today

petkit_fountain_care.description: Water, filter, battery and fault alerts for the Eversweet Max.

data.title: 🔋 Fountain battery low
data.message: {{ states('sensor.petkit_ctw3_battery_percent') }} % left. Put it back on the charger.

data.title: ⚠️ Fountain fault

data.title: 💧 Fountain filter due
data.message: Replace the filter, then press 'Reset filter' on the dashboard.

petkit_spray_after_visit.description: Neutralise odour 3 minutes after the cat leaves, without waiting for the clean. At most once per 30 minutes; never while the cat is near.

conditions.value_template: {{ trigger.from_state is not none and trigger.from_state.state | is_number and trigger.to_state.state | is_number and trigger.to_state.state | float > trigger.from_state.state | float }}

petkit_no_drink_alert.description: Fires only when BOTH: no drink at the fountain for 30 h AND at most one toilet visit in the last 24 h. Thresholds from her Petkit history (Oct-Nov 2026): fountain gaps over 24 h happen ~5x a month on their own.

triggers.value_template: {% set d = as_timestamp(states('sensor.petkit_ctw3_last_drink'), 0) %}{% set p = state_attr('input_datetime.cat_previous_toilet_visit','timestamp') | float(0) %}{{ d > 0 and now().timestamp() - d > 30*3600 and p > 0 and now().timestamp() - p > 24*3600 }}

data.title: 💧 Possible dehydration
data.message: No drink at the fountain since {{ as_timestamp(states('sensor.petkit_ctw3_last_drink'), 0) | timestamp_custom('%a %H:%M') }} and only one toilet visit in the last 24 hours (last {{ as_timestamp(states('input_datetime.cat_last_toilet_visit'), 0) | timestamp_custom('%a %H:%M') }}). Check she is drinking and urinating; call the vet if she seems unwell.
